title: Intermediate (MEC) with Integrated CA / CMA Foundation
tagline: MEC combines Intermediate studies with CA/CMA Foundation coaching, preparing students for accounting and finance careers.
eligibility: Pass in Class 10 (SSC) or equivalent from a recognised board.
board: Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh
overview: The MEC group (Mathematics, Economics, Commerce) is the natural launch-pad for a career in accounting and finance. In this integrated programme, students complete the regular two-year Intermediate course (Part I English, Part II Second Language, Part III Mathematics, Economics, Commerce) while receiving structured coaching for the CA Foundation or CMA Foundation examination, so that they are exam-ready by the time they finish Second Year.

sections.heading: Eligibility
paragraphs: Pass in Class 10 (SSC / CBSE / ICSE or equivalent). Students register with ICAI (for CA) or ICMAI (for CMA) at the Foundation level after Class 10; they can appear for the Foundation examination only after appearing for / passing Class 12 (Intermediate).

sections.heading: CA Course Structure & Examination Pattern
items: Stage 1 — CA Foundation: entry-level examination conducted by ICAI, held three times a year. Four papers of 100 marks each: Accounting, Business Laws, Quantitative Aptitude, Business Economics. Papers 3 and 4 are objective with negative marking (0.25 mark per wrong answer). Pass with minimum 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate in one sitting.

Stage 2 — CA Intermediate: six papers in two groups (each paper 100 marks), held three times a year. Students may attempt one group at a time or both together. ICITSS must be completed before articleship.
Stage 3 — Articleship: two years of practical training under a practising Chartered Accountant, with a stipend as per ICAI norms.

Stage 4 — CA Final: six papers in two groups, plus the self-paced online modules and Advanced ICITSS. On passing and completing training, the student becomes a member of ICAI — a Chartered Accountant.
Students who later complete a commerce degree with 55% (or non-commerce with 60%) can enter CA Intermediate directly without the Foundation (Direct Entry route).

sections.heading: CMA Course Structure & Examination Pattern
paragraphs: Conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI). Examinations are held in June and December.
CMA specialises in cost control, management accounting, costing systems and performance management — highly valued in manufacturing, infrastructure, PSUs and consulting.
items: CMA Foundation: four papers — Fundamentals of Business Laws and Business Communication; Fundamentals of Financial and Cost Accounting; Fundamentals of Business Mathematics and Statistics; Fundamentals of Business Economics and Management.
CMA Intermediate: eight papers in two groups.
CMA Final: eight papers in two groups, plus mandatory practical training (approximately 15 months) before qualifying.

sections.heading: Specializations
paragraphs: CA Foundation track / CMA Foundation track (students choose one; the Intermediate MEC syllabus is common to both).

sections.heading: Admission requirements
items: Transfer certificate, study certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar, passport-size photographs
